snippet.title: PI-EYED -=Classic Gaming=- Walkthrough, ZX Spectrum
snippet.description:
THE STORY SO FAR... Once, long ago, the PiMan was a pillar of moral society: a sober, righteous, boring little prude. "PIMANIA" and "GROUCHO" changed all that, as the PiMan shot to international stardom. Today he is a right little cult. But it has all been too much too fast. Yes folks, the PiMan is on skid row. He's hitting the bottle, weaving from pub to pub, causing havoc, mayhem and mess on the floor. Right now, our hero is totally PI-EYED. How many pints will he drink before he runs out of points...

RZX Archive public domain game file made by Albert Valls.

Released by Automata UK Ltd in 1984.
